# Introduction

The flint knife is the first knife.

### Combat style

• The flint knife's primary attack is a fast 3-slash combo with 2x damage on the last swing.
• Its secondary attack is a leaping stab with 3x damage.
• It deals 6x damage against unalerted enemies.
